### Observed differences

- In the later window, A08 appears far less often: participation drops from about 69% to 16% of traces, and mean occurrences per trace from 0.75 to 0.16. [OCC003]
- A04, A06 and A10 appear more often: participation rises from about 3–4% to 15–22% of traces. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC004]
- A08’s position shifts from near the end (mean relative position 0.91) to the middle (0.51). [POS001]
- A19 and A20 shift later (mean relative position from about 0.35 to 0.51). [POS002, POS003]
- A08’s outgoing transitions change: before, about 90% went to A46; after, only about 12% go to A46, with new targets A44, A15, A25 and A16. [DIR003]
- A19’s outgoing transitions change: before, about 97% went to A25; after, about 50% go to A27 and 44% to A28, with only 1% to A25. [DIR007]
- A20’s outgoing transitions change: before, about 96% went to A25; after, about 50% go to A27 and 47% to A28. [DIR008]
- A26’s outgoing transitions change: before, about 98% went to A27; after, about 48% go to A27, 26% to A19 and 24% to A20. [DIR009]
- A27’s outgoing transitions change: before, about 99% went to A28; after, about 52% go to A28, 24% to A19 and 22% to A20. [DIR010]
- A40’s outgoing transitions change: before, about 52% went to A19 and 44% to A20; after, about 82% go to A25. [DIR011]
- A45’s outgoing transitions change: before, about 66% went to A08 and 32% to A46; after, about 88% go to A46 and 2% to A08. [DIR013]
- A08’s co-occurrence with A25, A26, A27, A28, A40, A45 and A46 drops from about 69% to about 16% of traces. [REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006, REL007, REL008, REL009]
- The order between A19/A20 and A25/A26 reverses: before, A19/A20 preceded A25/A26 in about 45–54% of traces; after, A25/A26 precede A19/A20 in about 46–51% of traces. [REL010, REL011, REL013, REL014]
- Lag distances change: A19–A27 and A20–A27 go from lag 5 (about 99–100%) to lag 1 (about 94–98%). [LAG003, LAG004]
- A40–A19 and A40–A20 go from lag 1 (about 95–96%) to lag 5 (about 96–97%). [LAG015, LAG016]
- A40–A25 goes from lag 2 (96%) to lag 1 (83%). [LAG017]
- A45–A46 goes from lag 2 (68%) to lag 1 (88%). [LAG020]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports a structural change in the later part of the process: the previously common late activity A08 (present in about 69% of traces, near the end, followed by A46) becomes rare (about 16% of traces, earlier position), while activities A19 and A20, which previously led to A25, now lead to A27 and A28, and A40 now leads to A25 instead of A19/A20, and A45 now leads to A46 instead of A08. The reversal of order between A19/A20 and A25/A26, and the lag changes (A19/A20 now close to A27, A40 now far from A19/A20 and close to A25) are consistent with a replacement of an A08-based ending by an A19/A20–A27/A28-based ending. The large number of consistent indicators (57 items vs 0.77 expected by chance) makes sampling variation an unlikely explanation. Limitations: some lag items have very few supporting traces (e.g., LAG002 after 1, LAG005 before 1), and the exact control flow cannot be fully reconstructed from these indicators; the new sequence is inferred from direction and order changes, not directly observed.
